## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/timeline`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`TimelineComponent`](/api/timeline/TimelineComponent) | Component | Events in order along a line: each one's date, a marker on the line, and a card with its title, subtitle and description. |
| [`TimelineBodyTemplateDirective`](/api/timeline/TimelineBodyTemplateDirective) | Directive | Template for each event's details, in place of its description. |
| [`TimelineDateTemplateDirective`](/api/timeline/TimelineDateTemplateDirective) | Directive | Template for each event's date label, in place of its date formatted with `dateFormat`, such as a relative date. |
| [`TimelineHeaderTemplateDirective`](/api/timeline/TimelineHeaderTemplateDirective) | Directive | Template for each event's header, in place of its title and subtitle. |
| [`TimelineMarkerTemplateDirective`](/api/timeline/TimelineMarkerTemplateDirective) | Directive | Template for each event's marker on the line, in place of its dot, such as an icon for its status. |

### Types

| Type | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`TimelineEventTemplateContext`](/api/timeline/TimelineEventTemplateContext) | Interface | The context of a timeline's templates, `monaTimelineHeaderTemplate`, `monaTimelineBodyTemplate`, `monaTimelineDateTemplate` and `monaTimelineMarkerTemplate`: the event, as `let-event`. |
| [`TimelineOrientation`](/api/timeline/TimelineOrientation) | Type alias | Which way a timeline runs: `"vertical"`, down the page, or `"horizontal"`, across it in the reading direction, which is right to left in a right-to-left layout. |
